articles.summary: NEW YORK – [December 22, 2025] Coty Inc. (NYSE: COTY) (Paris: COTY) (“Coty” or “the Company”) today announced that Markus Strobel will become Executive Chairman of the Board and Interim Chief Executive Officer, effective January 1, 2026.
articles.title: COTY APPOINTS MARKUS STROBEL EXECUTIVE CHAIRMAN AND INTERIM CEO
